origine_fr: Il y a plus de 3 000 ans, 力 dessinait une bêche qu'on enfonce du pied. Plus tard, on y a vu les muscles tendus d'un homme : la force. Sous 田, le champ, il forme 男, l'homme qui met sa force aux champs.
origine_en: Over 3,000 years ago, 力 drew a spade pushed into the ground with the foot. Later, people saw in it a man's tensed muscles: strength. Under 田, the field, it makes 男, the man who puts his strength into the fields.

mots.en: to put effort in, to push hard

phrase.fr: Elle force pour ouvrir la porte.
phrase.en: She pushes hard to open the door.
